name: Arcanaloth
damage_resistances: Cold; Fire; Lightning; Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The arcanaloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The arcanaloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The arcanaloth's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The arcanaloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). The arcanaloth can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: alter self, darkness, heat metal, invisibility (self only), magic missile

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The arcanaloth is a 16th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The arcanaloth has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation Level 1 (4 slots): detect magic, identify, shield, Tenser's floating disk Level 2 (3 slots): detect thoughts, mirror image, phantasmal force, suggestion Level 3 (3 slots): counterspell, fear, fireball Level 4 (3 slots): banishment, dimension door Level 5 (2 slots): contact other plane, hold monster Level 6 (1 slots): chain lightning Level 7 (1 slots): finger of death Level 8 (1 slots): mind blank
